pairing: For each machine/date, choose latest identical HH:mm on current and previous day inside the daily selected time window.
legacyOil: oil is pressure (bar); do not convert dailyOil/oilUsage to cumulative.
duplicate: latest applicable revision per record and slot
rangeTotal: sum valid per-machine daily results once
timeFilter: inclusive HH:mm window applied on every date
export: same model; previous-day records only as comparison columns
